ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the macro-ventral surface; estimated high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) ratio is less than 0.05, with high-intensity pixels primarily localized to water droplets and the distal-right edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 40-45 degrees; apex depth is sharply defined at the central fluke junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of serration peaks varies from 5 to 25 pixels relative to the local mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex trailing edge trajectory on both lobes, heavily modulated by high-frequency irregular serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of approximately 15-20 high-intensity circular/ellipsoid pixel groups localized on the extreme distal-lateral margin of the right fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical-to-diagonal parallel linear disruptions (rake-like marks) visible as slight intensity shifts in the lower-medial dark pixel field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent colonization of high-contrast structural masses on the far-right lobe tip; irregular trailing edge profile with multiple small-scale U-shaped and V-shaped tissue voids.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast silhouette at the extreme right distal tip caused by a localized concentration of protruding calcified structural masses.
